thread:
jen_support: Heads-up — multiple hosted inference customers seeing 502/503 on /v1/generate since ~09:12 UTC. Error rate up ~6%, p95 latency spiked. Tenants: 5003, 6212, 8100. No billing breaks reported yet.

liam_sre: On it. Is this only hosted API or also Dedicated/Private?

jen_support: Only hosted so far (us-east-1). Customers report gateway 502 with body mentioning control-plane failures.

sarah_eng: I'll check control-plane services (auth/session, routing-policy, config-db). I already see a config-db timeout spike around 09:11 UTC. Pinging infra.

infra-bot: alert: config-db read replica latency increased at 2026-02-18T09:11:40Z. 95th latency 1.2s -> 4.6s, connection timeouts rising. Affected pod: config-db-2.

liam_sre: Repro (from an impacted tenant):
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'

Response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Body: {"error":"controlplane: routing-policy error"}

Gateway log snippet:
{"ts":"2026-02-18T09:12:03Z","svc":"gateway","msg":"upstream 502","upstream":"routing-policy","tenant":"5003","err":"timeout waiting for configdb"}

sarah_eng: Routing-policy is returning 500s when it calls config-db; also seeing session-store auth calls return intermittent 401s that get translated to 502s by the gateway when routing fails. Looks like a config-db read path bottleneck + auth token verification backoffs.

ops_bot: Mitigation suggestion: temporarily route requests with missing routing-policy to a local fallback (stateless routing) to avoid the control-plane hop. Set ROUTING_POLICY_MODE=prefer-local for hosted-gateway canary.

liam_sre: I can flip the flag on canary now, then roll to clusters if good. Any objections?

dan_product: Approve for customer impact mitigation. Notify support and include ETA.

jen_support: I'll draft a short customer message: "We're investigating increased 5xx on hosted API; mitigation in progress; estimated restoration within 1 hour." Will include request IDs once collected.

sarah_eng: Short-term engineering actions I propose:
- increase routing-policy client timeout 500ms -> 1500ms for 1 hour
- enable local-cache TTL extension in routing-policy
- scale config-db read replicas +1
I'll push a small canary config to routing-policy pods.

liam_sre: Doing steps now:
- 09:20 UTC: flip ROUTING_POLICY_MODE on gateway canary
- 09:21 UTC: apply routing-policy timeout patch to canary
- 09:25 UTC: scale config-db readpool +1
- 09:30 UTC: observe metrics/alerts

infra-bot: Action: scaled config-db-readpool -> +1 node (node-cfg-5) started at 2026-02-18T09:26:12Z.

jen_support: Sent initial customer notifications for tenants 5003/6212/8100. Asking customers to share request_id headers if they have them.

sarah_eng: Canary results: after timeout bump + cache extension, routing-policy 5xx dropped from 14% -> 1.5% on canary; gateway 502s for canary traffic reduced. Pushing config to remaining gateways in waves.

liam_sre: After full roll: overall error-rate dropped from ~6% -> ~0.8% and p95 latency back to baseline. Monitoring for 30m before closing.

jen_support: Customers acknowledged initial update and said they're seeing fewer errors. Will keep them posted and close when fully recovered.

dan_product: Good work. Please capture RCA items: cause (config-db read pressure), why auth/session calls amplified errors, and long-term fixes (connection pool sizing, retry/backoff adjustments, fallback routing).

liam_sre: Creating incident INC-20260218-042 and will link this thread + logs.

ops_bot: Reminder: attach at least 3 example request_ids and a sample gateway log to the incident ticket for postmortem.

customer_escalation_bot: Customer ticket CS-89012 opened for tenant 5003 and linked to INC-20260218-042.

jen_support: Thanks everyone. Next steps: 1) monitor for 30m, 2) collect RCAs and perf diffs, 3) follow up with affected customers with root cause and permanent timeline.

liam_sre: Final note: config-db autoscaling config under review — we might add burst read capacity and improve client backoff logic to prevent similar cascades.

sarah_eng: Will schedule follow-up RFC for permanent fixes.

jen_support: OK closing Slack thread for now; will post final incident link when RCA is ready. :white_check_mark:
